title: Viva Engage: enhanced Microsoft Copilot with Engage tools, work context and agents
summary: The briefing's licensing, default state, roadmap facts and control calls are supported by Microsoft documentation. The updated plugin guidance qualifies blocking: it affects new conversations, while conversations already using the plugin continue until they end. The abbreviated checklist paths and a conflicting feature-access-management reference also need clarification.
